title: DRIP (Decentralised TripAdvisor)
tagline: DRIP (Decentralised TripAdvisor for people to find authentic review using WorldCoin to prove humanity and POAP to attest attendance.
description:
DRIP is public good portal for consumers for authentic and verified reviews. 
Problem addressed: prevents people to make fake reviews without ever having being there. Better review system based proof of humanity and proof of attendance.
With DRIP, enables economic value of online reviews with focus on content, proof of
how_its_made:
How it’s Made

WorldCoin - user needs to verify that he/she is human and this can be done by using WorldCoin ID. 

ApeCoin: A consumer can add additional tipps to a restaurant if wanted using ApeCoin.

The Graph: We have written a subgraph which fetch dynamic NFT data of the user.

You are only allowed to write a review if you pass proof of humanity using WorldCoin and proof of attendance by issuance of attestation of the restaurant. 

A review can contain stars, title, comment and avatar + ENS 

Reviews are stored on-chain in SQL database thanks to Cartesi.
